geminicodeassist.customCommands.requeriments-analysis: Genera la documentacion de requisitos del artefacto que a continuación se menciona:

geminicodeassist.rules:
-   All the documentation that you generate or update, as well as the comments in the  code, the names of classes, methods, functions and variables must be in  English.
-  All documentation for requirements (/requeriment analysis) of an artifact that is analyzed will follow, as far as possible, the guidelines of the example `workDocuments/Requirements-Document-in-Markdown.md` and will be saved in the directory `workDocuments` with a name formed by the name of the artifact joined with a dash to the word `requirements` and the extension .md. 
- The documentation generated by /requirement analysis must be exhaustive, without going into details of concrete implementations, but mentioning patterns, strategies, or styles. It should be taken into account that the ultimate goal of this documentation, once corrected, will be the construction of another artifact with similar functionality and characteristics.
-  The information not available at the time of the requirements analysis will be reflected in the document with the corresponding titles and the indication of not available, to be filled in "by hand" at a later time.
